analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (head line 3) and adds a paragraph at head lines 715-719 (in the part of the file not shown in the supplied units). That paragraph says required/named tool_choice on a Qwen 3.5-family checkpoint accepts the inferred .qwen35 parser or .xmlFunction, and that both concrete Qwen3.8-27B builds, including the embedded-MTP one, advertise forced tools via ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift. No code, config, crypto, authorization, attestation, cache storage or wire-protocol behavior changes. The head units supplied cover head lines 1-403. The added lines 715-719 are only visible in the patch excerpt, not in numbered head text. The base units cover lines 829-1195, which are unchanged context.

The canonical threats (T-041, T-008 and the TB-002/TB-007 items) are not touched by this documentation change. I did not verify the claim about ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift because that file is not supplied. This is a documentation claim only, so it is not a finding. The tool-choice enforcement behavior is a possible availability/correctness concern, but the supplied evidence does not show any regression. The next pass needs no cross-file follow-up unless that Swift file changes in the same PR.
